description: On multi-connector hardware an empty `as` field yields an empty-string per-connector meter value, which MySQL strict mode rejects for the INT column -- throwing and stranding the frame. Only reachable once per-connector charge_points rows exist, so known issue 1 currently masks it. Found by the property suite (seed 20260907).

phases.label: provision connector rows, then send an empty as field

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbox WHERE status NOT IN ('new','done','bad')
SELECT wh FROM charge_points WHERE cp_ident='CP-0002'
